title: Nexus NPC'S
description: Just another Npc plugin for multiverse core servers
body:
Command:
What it does
/npc create <name>
Spawns NPC at your feet
/npc setworld <npc> <world>
Sets where it teleports players
/npc setname <npc> <text>
Change display name (supports & colors)
/npc setteleport <npc>
Sets exact landing spot to your position
/npc delete <name>
Remove an NPC
/npc list
See all NPCs + destinations
